integrity_statement: All mathematical arguments and finite check methods are supplied. This is a self-review only; no independent mathematical audit or formal certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem applies to flat meet-semilattices of one zero and n incomparable atoms; it does not prove a limit uniformly over all finite semilattices. Equivalent unindexed older enumerations remain possible.
title: Exact diagonal-relation census and random-digraph law for flat semilattices
